*Steps to reproduce*

# Navigate to App GO Train Schedules and Claims (GooglePlays)
# Download App to mobile Pixel 7(Android)
# Open the App after downloading.
# Enable auto-rotate and rotate the phone to the right or left.

*Expected result*
The expected result when rotating the screen to the right is that the app should adjust its layout to fit the new width and height without changing the overall appearance, only the parameters.

After changing the screen orientation to the right or left, the app adjusted its width and height to fit the phone’s position. Everything remained unchanged, except that the app became less convenient to use, as the central area became narrower and displayed fewer available routes.

*Expected result*
When opening the app without network access, the app notifies the user that there is no network and that a connection is required. Saved route searches are available to the user, but creating new routes will be impossible.

*Actual result*

The app opens and displays the user’s recent searches. When searching for a new route, the system notifies the user of a connection issue, making it impossible to search for new routes. Only previously saved routes are available, without any updates.

Steps to reproduce

1. Navigate to App GO Train Schedules and Claims (GooglePlays)
2. Download App to mobile Pixel 7(Android)
3. Open the App after downloading.

Expected result
When opening the app for the first time, the Go Train app requests access to the user’s location data. The user can allow access temporarily while using the app, allow access for continuous use, or deny access.


Actual result
When opening the app, the system requests permission to allow the app to access the user’s location. It offers the choice of precise or approximate geolocation. The user is also given three options to choose from:
1.While using the app
2.Only this time
3.Deny
